meta.title: Sol system telecommunications, 2380
meta.description: Settled worlds, population and interplanetary telecom providers in the Sol system in 2380, generated by an agent-based simulation set in the Star Trek universe. Fan work; not official.

units.distance: km unless the field says Au

sources.title: Memory Alpha: Utopia Planitia Fleet Yards

companyKinds.name: Interplanetary backbone
companyKinds.description: Long-haul subspace transit between regions; grew out of a pre-subspace network.

companyKinds.name: Regional carrier
companyKinds.description: Relay network for one region; spun off from the backbone that opened it.

companyKinds.name: Local gateway
companyKinds.description: Local access and interplanetary uplink on one world.

companyKinds.name: Specialist
companyKinds.description: A network for one industry, science field or harsh environment.

canon.text: Chakotay trains in its storms in the 2340s (VOY "Future's End, Part II")
Terraforming stations operating (DS9 "Past Tense, Part I")
Telstar 1, the first active relay satellite (real history; used as Earth's first relay)
Settlements exist, tied to Utopia Planitia (ENT "Terra Nova")
Terraforming under way; lowlands need only thermal clothing and oxygen (ENT "Demons", "Terra Prime")
Jupiter Station services Starfleet and Earth Cargo Service ships (ENT "Fortunate Son")
Navigational control satellites in orbit (TNG "The First Duty")
New Berlin built between 2063 and 2069 (ENT "Terra Nova")
Over 50 million inhabitants (Star Trek: First Contact)
Inhabited: Scott has a drink he found there (TOS "By Any Other Name")
Human research colony, undated (DIS "People of Earth")
